title: Hyperliquid Interface Terms of Use — public static asset verification
method: Read public HTML and its linked JavaScript assets using anonymous HTTP. The canonical terms page is a SPA and web text extraction was empty. No account, wallet, geolocation spoofing or authenticated session was used.

clause_summaries.1.6: Interface eligibility excludes specified restricted jurisdictions, territories subject to applicable sanctions or export controls, and citizens of Restricted Territories regardless of location.
clause_summaries.3.1.5: Prohibits concealing location by VPN or proxy, misstating citizenship or residency, and circumventing geoblocking.

iran_assessment: Iran is not literally enumerated in the verified interface clause. Treating Iran as falling under its sanctions-territory definition is an inference supported by the official OFAC Iran program and the Foundation node policy, which names Iran; this is not an independent legal opinion.
scope_limitations: Interface terms are not proof that every HyperEVM application has identical terms.
No Iran-IP request or actual enforcement test was performed.
Asset name is build-specific and may disappear after redeployment.
Full copyrighted JavaScript text was not retained.
decision: RESEARCH_ONLY; no live authorization or access workaround
